links.outcome: Reading grade level of GenAI responses to patient questions (Flesch-Kincaid Reading Ease, Grade Level, SMOG)
links.effect: All four models (Kimi, DeepSeek, ChatGPT, Gemini) produced responses requiring 11th-grade to college reading level.
links.quote: The responses produced by all models required a reading capacity from 11th-grade to college level.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the baseline accuracy and readability of several LLMs (DeepSeek, ChatGPT, Kimi, Gemini) on esophageal and gastric cancer patient queries; it does not test a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
